# govulncheck accepted-risk list
#
# Vulnerabilities listed here are reachable from check-self and are knowingly
# accepted, because no fixed release exists upstream. Any called vulnerability
# NOT listed here fails CI.
#
# Format: one Go vulnerability database ID per line. Everything after a '#' is
# a comment. Each block must record why the risk is accepted and when to
# re-check it. Delete an entry as soon as a fixed version exists and is adopted.
#
# Used by .github/scripts/govulncheck.sh (CI and `make govulncheck`).

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# github.com/lib/pq - all versions affected, no fixed release.
#
# Reported: 2026-08-18. Re-check by: 2026-11-18.
#
# check-self reaches these through go-databasing's PostgreSQL connector in
# checkself/checkdatabaseurl.go, which opens a connection and pings it to
# confirm that an operator-supplied database URL actually works.
#
# Accepted because every one of these requires a hostile PostgreSQL server:
# the failure modes are panics, CPU/memory exhaustion, and credential
# disclosure driven by malicious server responses. check-self is a short-lived
# diagnostic CLI that connects only to the database the operator names and
# exits immediately afterward. Anyone who can set the database URL can already
# point the tool at a server of their choosing, so accepting these grants no
# capability an operator does not already have.
#
# Remediation is upstream: either a fixed lib/pq release, or moving
# senzing-garage/go-databasing from lib/pq to pgx. Drop this whole block once
# either lands and check-self picks it up.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GO-2026-6166  # GSS authentication completes without mutual proof
GO-2026-6168  # Unbounded iteration count causes CPU denial of service (scram)
GO-2026-6169  # Disclosure of wrong .pgpass credential via hostaddr
GO-2026-6170  # Malformed backend frame length causes panic
GO-2026-6171  # Malformed RowDescription and DataRow messages cause panics
GO-2026-6172  # Backend frame lengths cause pre-validation memory exhaustion
GO-2026-6173  # Pre-protocol error reader permits unbounded memory consumption
